video_metadata.title: Domen Prevc sets NEW WORLD RECORD in Planica SLOVENIA | FIS Ski Jumping World Cup 24-25
video_metadata.description: Thank you for watching, don’t forget to like, subscribe.

definitions.time: video time in seconds (broadcast replays are often slow motion)
definitions.angle: 2-D angle (deg) between the body line (mid-ankle -> mid-shoulder) and the ski axis. Positive = body above the skis. null for frontal/rear views, outliers or when no ski was found.
definitions.angle_leg / angle_torso: same with mid-ankle -> mid-hip / mid-hip -> mid-shoulder
definitions.angle_raw: angle before outlier rejection (reported even for frontal views)
definitions.outlier: angle_raw > 15 deg from the median of its neighbours (+-0.3 s, same shot) or with < 2 such neighbours
definitions.angle_smooth: median of 3 neighbouring samples in the same shot
definitions.knee_angle / hip_angle: mean of left/right interior 2-D joint angles, 180 = straight
definitions.view: side | oblique | frontal (estimated from body width ratio and ski V)
definitions.confidence: 0..1 heuristic (pose visibility x ski support x view)
definitions.camera_motion_px: [dx, dy, response] global image shift since previous sample
definitions.body.keypoints_2d: 33 MediaPipe landmarks: [x_px, y_px, z_rel_px, visibility]; z is relative depth (smaller = closer to camera), same scale as x
definitions.body.keypoints_3d: MediaPipe world landmarks, metres, origin = mid-hip, axes aligned with the camera (x right, y down, z away); model estimate
definitions.body.joint_angles_2d / _3d: interior angles, deg, 180 = straight. shoulder = upper arm vs trunk side (arm-trunk angle); ankle = shank vs foot; neck = head centre - mid-shoulder - mid-hip. 2-D values are null when a keypoint is not visible
definitions.body.posture_3d: view-independent posture from 3-D landmarks: leg_spread (angle between thighs), arm_spread, trunk_twist, head_to_trunk, separations in metres (approximate scale), centre of mass (m)
definitions.body.segment_inclination_2d: each segment vs image horizontal, deg, y up
definitions.body.relative_to_ski_2d: each segment vs the ski axis, deg (signed, + = above skis)
definitions.body.distances_rel_2d: image distances divided by body length (ankle->shoulder)
definitions.body.center_of_mass_vs_ski: body CoM (de Leva segment masses, without skis) relative to mid-ankle, along the ski (+ = towards tips) and above it, in body lengths
definitions.skis: per ski tail/tip points (px), length, inclination; v_angle_2d = opening between the skis in the image (meaningful in frontal/rear views)
definitions.segments: continuous airborne periods with statistics, take-off/landing estimates and overlay context (speed, athletes, texts)
definitions.shots: camera shots between detected cuts with a coarse type
definitions.ocr_events: all on-screen texts with first/last time and normalised box
